comment: Pacing thresholds a scenario's checks.pacing gets on a rig whose GPU name contains `match` (the file rig.txt a run records from nvidia-smi). The scenarios' own numbers are for a desktop GPU. The laptop's measured run (2026-10-27, e2e_openxr_probe): client p99 22.1 ms, 2.9 % of frames one period late, host intake p99 25.0-30.3 ms; on 2026-10-08/09 the same laptop measured p99 about 14 ms and 0 % late, so these are a ceiling for the present state, not a target: a further regression still fails.
